reviews.text: Excellent service and attention. I went with my rabbit, and although there was little that could be done for her—she was dying—they were clear from the start and did what little they could. Excellent service; they made room for me right away. I highly recommend them. Thank you for your kindness.

I've been with their amazing team for years now, taking my dog ​​there from when she was a puppy until now, at 15 years old. Throughout all this time, they've been incredibly friendly and, above all, honest. We're so grateful for their care and advice, and even if Xahara doesn't want to admit it, I'm sure she appreciates it too. Special mention to Naima and Ana, who we spend the most time with, but Rubén and Miguel are also fantastic. Thank you so much!
Excellent service. I'm delighted with them. They gave me great advice about exporting a rabbit, and responded quickly. I'm very grateful.

We went to this clinic because our usual vet was on vacation, and we had read good reviews, which I can certainly vouch for. The care from both the assistant and the vet, Naima, was outstanding. Our dog, Zazú, had a bacterial infection. They reassured us with the treatment, and over the days he has gained weight and mobility. We are very happy and grateful to this clinic. I highly recommend them. If my usual vet ever lets me down again, I won't hesitate to go back.

We regret that your experience with us was not satisfactory. Without any feedback, we cannot determine what happened or identify your case for review. If you wish, you can contact the clinic, and we would be happy to hear from you and clarify the situation.
Years of caring for my animals, for me you are the best
Excellent care for my Argentine parrot. They also gave me some very helpful advice.
We've been using them for 8 years, taking our rabbits, and we hope for many more. Exceptional service.

Without a doubt, the best exotic pet clinic in Madrid. Pocholo 🐰 and we are delighted with the care and the great professionalism of Miguel and Naima. Naima is a sweetheart ❤️ of a veterinarian, with exquisite treatment for us and also for our grumpy grandpa 🤭🤣
Many thanks to the whole team: Miguel, Naima, Rubén, and Ana for always treating us so well and with so much love!!
Thank you so much for your review, Alberto!

I have no words to describe how incredible Naima is.
I'm never going to any other vet but her.
For five months I was trying to figure out what was wrong with my rat, Margot. They kept telling me it was an abscess and that it would heal with antibiotics. As soon as Naima saw her, she suggested cutting her open to see what was inside. She found a huge tumor that didn't even need a biopsy.

A tumor that, after five months at three different vets, no one had been able to see.

She's not only a fantastic professional, you can tell she knows what she's talking about. She explains all the possibilities and doesn't waste your time with unnecessary tests.
The best part, and what really made me cry, was when my dad came home and told me she hadn't charged us for the surgery (we had to put her to sleep because there was nothing else that could be done after the operation).
It's not about price anymore, it's about humanity and professionalism.

I'm speechless, truly.

From now on, I plan to take all my animals to her, without exception.

Thank you so much, Naima
❤️❤️❤️
We have a rabbit. Miguel and Naimar have taken excellent care of us, and the reception staff have always been very helpful with appointments, prescriptions, etc.
Very friendly. Direct communication is always appreciated.
Excellent professionals. I started by taking my hedgehog there, and then for nine years they took great care of my rabbit. I highly recommend this center if you have exotic pets. :)
We don't know how things will turn out, but as of today, we owe them our dog's life.
Everything's fine 🙂 …

The best veterinarian in Madrid.

If you're looking for professionalism, this is the clinic for you.
They helped me many times with my rabbits
Thank you.

Our pet, Kiwi, is a lovebird and a beloved member of the family. We bought him 13 years ago at a veterinary clinic in Villaviciosa de Odón. On May 10th, while we were taking him out, he fainted and hit his head. We immediately took him back to the same vet, but they didn't seem very interested. After the second visit, seeing that things weren't looking good, we decided to take him to Madrid Exóticos. I can honestly say he's alive thanks to them. We asked them many questions, which they answered. They changed his medication, recommended a specialized formula for him, and he was hospitalized for a week. They pulled him through; everything was so easy. From the very first moment, the treatment was professional and friendly; they truly care about the animals.

We don't know how long Kiwi will live with us, but we are deeply grateful to everyone who has treated us at this clinic, especially Dr. Nayma! Thank you so much.
